title: Drifter Bar Salts Lime Raspberry Cherry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Lime Raspberry Cherry by Drifter Bar Salts delivers a bold trio of vibrant fruit flavours. A zesty burst of Lime cuts through the sweetness, balanced by the juicy sharpness of Raspberry and the rich, tart edge of Cherry. The result is a lively, layered vape with just the right mix of sweet and tangy notes. This nic salt e-liquid is crafted with a 50% PG / 50% VG blend, offering a smooth throat hit, rapid nicotine relief, and discreet vapour production. Available in 5mg, 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, it’s ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles, especially when paired with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Drifter Bar Salts are designed to capture the punchy, mouth-watering flavours of disposable vapes in a reusable e-liquid format, helping you enjoy your favourite blends while saving money and reducing waste. Why not try other incredible flavours from Drifter's Bar Salts and Bar Juice collections? From Watermelon Strawberry Bubblegum to Blueberry and Cherry, to Strawberry Raspberry Cherry and Blackcurrant Ice, whatever your taste in e-liquid, Drifter E-liquid has an incredible flavour waiting to light up your tastebuds.
